challenges.name: md5 (CDUT local)
challenges.description: A PHP page requires three checks: a1 != a2 but md5(a1) == md5(a2) (GET params, loose comparison), b1 != b2 but md5(b1) === md5(b2) (POST params, strict comparison), and a cookie c1 where c1 == md5(c1). Satisfy all three and the flag is echoed. The service runs at http://host.docker.internal:<port>/.

challenges.name: baby_rce (CDUT local)
challenges.description: A PHP page runs system($_GET['cmd']) but blocks 'cat', 'flag', 'more', 'less', 'head', 'tail', 'bash', 'sh', ';', backtick, '|', '>', '<' in the command. The flag was written to /flag at container start. Execute a command that reads /flag despite the filter. The service runs at http://host.docker.internal:<port>/.
